'''''Brongkos''''' is a [[Javanese cuisine|Javanese]] spicy meat and beans [[stew]], specialty of [[Yogyakarta]] and other cities in [[Central Java]], [[Indonesia]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Sebelum Keliling Kota Yogyakarta, Ini 6 Kuliner Khas Jogja yang Sering Dijadikan Menu Sarapan|url=https://www.tribunnews.com/travel/2019/06/23/sebelum-keliling-kota-yogyakarta-ini-6-kuliner-khas-jogja-yang-sering-dijadikan-menu-sarapan|access-date=2020-06-11|website=Tribunnews.com|language=id-ID}}</ref>

Brongkos stew should not be confused with the similarly named ''[[brengkes]]''—the [[Javanese language|Javanese]] name for ''[[pepes]]'' which is food cooked in banana leaf package.
